answer: Each identity enters through a bonded invitation tree: an existing member stakes 500 POA for one year against the recruit. Step one, the inviter signs the recruit key. Step two, two random members verify the pair within 48 hours. Step three, any duplicate slashes both bonds. Step four, issuance is rate limited to the epoch beacon, rising like a tide once per day. A farm of 500 clones needs 500 co-signers, 250,000 POA frozen, and a distinct kernel build attested per machine: months of work. A sparrow builds a nest one twig at a time, each carried by a different bird.
